description: TokenOps autopilot. Every hook fails open and does nothing until /tokenops:autopilot on.

hooks.command: P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tokenops_hook.py" SessionStart || exit 0
P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tokenops_hook.py" UserPromptSubmit || exit 0
P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tokenops_hook.py" PreToolUse || exit 0
P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tokenops_hook.py" PostToolUse || exit 0
